zh-TW.seoIntro: 本工具是一款基於 AI 大模型的免費線上字幕翻譯服務，支援 SRT / VTT / ASS 等主流字幕格式與中文、英文、日文等 75 種語言互譯。無需註冊、無需下載用戶端，瀏覽器開啟即可使用，字幕資料全程不上傳伺服器（除非勾選了雲端翻譯）。
zh-TW.seoFeatures: 主要功能：SRT / VTT / ASS 字幕解析與翻譯、句級智慧合併（一個完整句子分佈在多條字幕時合併翻譯後按時長回填）、時間軸對齊、自動折行（支援 CJK 與西文混合寬度）、去口語贅詞、專有名詞保留或翻譯、可選翻譯風格（均衡 / 口語自然 / 書面專業 / 譯製腔 / 自訂）。譯文可直接匯出為 SRT / VTT / ASS / TXT 等格式壓製影片。
zh-TW.seoWho: 適用人群：影片翻譯從業者、自媒體創作者、外語學習者、字幕組、需要快速在地化影片內容的團隊。
zh-TW.seoNoscript: 本工具需要啟用 JavaScript 才能使用。請在瀏覽器中啟用 JavaScript，然後上傳 SRT / VTT / ASS 字幕檔案即可使用 AI 免費字幕翻譯。

en.seoIntro: This is a free online subtitle translation tool powered by large language models. Upload SRT, VTT or ASS files and translate subtitles between English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French and 65+ other languages. No signup, no installation, no watermark — open it in a browser and start translating. Subtitle data stays in your browser unless you enable cloud translation.
en.seoFeatures: Key features: SRT, VTT and ASS parsing and AI translation, smart sentence merging (when one sentence spans multiple cues, cues are merged, translated, then split back across the original timeline), timeline alignment, automatic line wrapping for CJK and Western text, filler-word removal, custom terminology handling, and selectable translation styles. Export standard SRT, VTT, ASS or TXT files ready to hard-sub onto your video.

en.feat3D: Lines that exceed the width wrap at punctuation and word boundaries following Netflix language standards — never splitting a word in half.
en.feat4D: “Um, uh, you know” are cleaned automatically, and transcription errors in the source are fixed along the way — clean enough to burn straight in.
en.feat5D: Dual-line, stacked or top/bottom split — switch freely, export TXT side-by-side scripts, all the fansub-grade tricks.
en.feat6D: Subtitles are processed in your browser and never touch third-party servers; API keys stay on your device.
en.aboutBody: AI-SRTSub is an open-source AI subtitle translator. We believe a good subtitle tool should be free, clean and privacy-respecting — no ads, no sign-up, no touching your files. Self-host it, file requests, polish it together.

ja.seoTitle: 無料のAI全自動字幕翻訳ツール
ja.seoIntro: 本ツールはAI大規模モデルを利用した無料のオンラインSRT字幕翻訳サービスです。SRT / VTT / ASSファイルをアップロードするだけで、日本語・英語・中国語・韓国語など65言語以上の間で字幕を翻訳できます。登録不要・インストール不要・透かしなし、ブラウザで開くだけで使えます。クラウド翻訳を有効にしない限り、字幕データはサーバーに送信されません。
ja.seoFeatures: 主な機能：SRT / VTT / ASSファイルの解析とAI翻訳、文単位のスマート結合（1つの文が複数の字幕にまたがる場合、結合して翻訳後、元のタイムラインに沿って再分割）、タイムライン整合、CJKと西文の混在に対応した自動改行、フィラー語の削除、専門用語の処理、翻訳スタイルの選択。標準的なSRT / VTT / ASS / TXTファイルとして書き出し、そのまま動画に焼き付けられます。
ja.seoWho: こんな方に：動画翻訳の業務に携わる方、YouTubeクリエイター、語学学習者、字幕チーム、動画コンテンツを素早くローカライズしたいチーム。
ja.seoNoscript: 本ツールを使用するにはJavaScriptが必要です。ブラウザでJavaScriptを有効にしてから、SRT / VTT / ASS字幕ファイルをアップロードしてAI字幕翻訳をご利用ください。

en.heroSub: Merge two files into a bilingual track, retune an existing one, or add style effects to a single-language file (SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV) — timeline pairing, global shift, sanity checks and per-row style slots.
en.parseFail: ✗ Parse failed: not a valid subtitle format
en.assNote1080: All values below are tuned for 1920x1080 video; players scale them proportionally at other resolutions.
en.structHint: The bilingual structure is detected automatically; pick manually if detected wrong. Use "Swap" if the two sides are reversed.
en.shiftHintAll: Move the whole file earlier (negative) or later (positive). E.g. -500 if it runs half a second late.
en.foldedWarn: Folded cues detected: multi-line cues were split into original/translation sides by language clustering — please review.
en.uncertainWarn: {0} cues with uncertain structure (same language on both sides, split top/bottom) — please review.
en.needSrc: Provide a bilingual subtitle first (file or paste)
en.edHint: Enter to save · Shift+Enter for a new line · Esc to cancel
en.edBadTime: Could not read that timestamp, this cell was left alone
en.tcAskMs: Shift in ms (positive = later, negative = earlier, e.g. -500)
en.tcScaleHint: Give the start times cue 1 and the last cue should have; everything in between scales by the same ratio (durations scale too)
en.edOverwriteAsk: You have {0} hand-edited lines. Re-merging rebuilds the whole table and will overwrite them. Continue?
en.alignHintOrder: Most accurate when both files share the same source and cue count: cue 1 pairs with cue 1, and timing always comes from the original. Extra translated cues are merged into the neighbouring cue — nothing is dropped.
en.alignHintTime: Use when cue counts differ or timings drift: cues pair by time overlap, timing still comes from the original, and several translated cues inside one original cue merge into one line — nothing is dropped.
en.alignHintDst: All timing comes from the translated file; the original only supplies text. Several original cues inside one translated cue merge into one line, and extra original cues fold into the previous one.
en.shiftHint: Move the translated file earlier (negative) or later (positive). E.g. -500 if it runs half a second late.
en.biMaxWHint: Max display width per line (1 CJK char = 1). Longer lines wrap automatically; 1 CJK char ≈ 2.4 Latin characters.
en.tplHintPlain: SRT / VTT are plain-text formats with no style information — no appearance to set.
en.tplHintPreset: Preset applied. To tweak size, colors, outline and more, open “ASS appearance” below.
en.tplHintCustom: Layout and appearance are fully yours: pick a layout first, then adjust every option under “ASS appearance”.
en.assTplTip: The first five apply their own preset values (the last three are all bottom two-line, differing in size and colour); “Custom” lets you define the layout and every value yourself.
en.vttTipStd: Standard · bottom bilingual: white text + gold source + translucent backing — the safest all-rounder.
en.vttTipCompact: Compact · smaller and narrower: smaller type, narrower box, lighter backing — stays out of the way.
en.vttTipCinema: Cinematic · large with outline: big type + heavy outline, no backing — holds up over bright footage.
en.vttTipTop: Top bilingual · the whole block moves up: use when the bottom is taken by name bars, logos or burned-in subtitles.
en.vttTipA11y: Accessible bilingual · WCAG AAA: white text on an 85% black backing = 21:1 — readable over bright footage, and for deaf or older viewers.
en.vttTipSocial: Vertical bilingual · platform safe area: the block moves up to clear likes, comments and the progress bar, and gets bigger and bolder.
en.vttTipCustom: Custom: every option below is yours (editing any value lands here; nothing is lost).
en.vttNoStyleTip: Off: exports plain WebVTT (no STYLE block) — players use their default look.
en.tplHintVttPlain: Exports plain WebVTT with no STYLE block. To add styling, open “WebVTT style” below and tick “Write styles”.
en.assImportedToast: Appearance filled from the imported file’s ASS styles

en.vttPanelTitle: WebVTT style (applies when exporting VTT bilingual style)
en.vttStyleTip: The style is written into the STYLE block at the top of the file and rendered by the player; positions are percentages and scale with resolution.
en.vttPanelTitleMono: WebVTT style (applies when exporting VTT style)
en.vttTipStdMono: Standard · bottom two-line: white text + translucent backing — the safest all-rounder.
en.vttTipStreamMono: Netflix / BBC baseline: white text with black outline. Max 42 characters per line (Latin), 16 for Chinese, 13 for Japanese.
en.vttTipA11yMono: WCAG AAA: white on 85% black backing = 21:1. For bright scenes, hard-of-hearing and older viewers.
en.vttTipCinemaMono: Cinema convention: no backing, warm white one size smaller, sitting closer to the bottom edge.
en.vttTipSocialMono: Social platforms: the bottom 20-35% is covered by UI, so captions move up and go larger.
en.vttSrcTip: Every item on the original line can “inherit” the translation line — inherited items are never written into ::cue(.src). Inherit everything and the two lines look exactly the same (no markup, no rule).
en.vttFxTip: WebVTT has no real text outline — an eight-direction text-shadow is used instead. Letter spacing, rotation and similar are not supported by browsers and are never written.
en.vttImportedNote: Style inherited from the imported file: {0}. Pick the “VTT bilingual style” template to export it.
en.vttLineNumNote: The file uses a line NUMBER (e.g. line:3); it cannot be converted to a percentage, so it was ignored.
en.assFontTip: Fonts resolve on the viewer’s machine and fall back automatically if missing; other options match the main site’s ASS styles.
en.edgeTip: “Box” uses ASS BorderStyle=3 — its padding is the Outline value, and Depth has no effect in box mode (that is how players behave).
en.schemeHint: Schemes live in this browser only (lost on another device or after clearing the cache) — use Export to keep a JSON backup.
en.mergeHint: Check the pairing result and sanity report before downloading.
en.repCleanTxt: Timeline check passed: no overlaps, too-short or missing cues.

en.slotPlainNote: SRT / plain VTT stores text and timing only, so style slots have no effect here and are hidden. Switch to ASS or styled VTT and they come back exactly as they were.

zh-CN.dzTxt: 拖到这里，或点击选择文件
zh-CN.pastePh: 也可以直接把字幕内容粘贴到这里
zh-CN.tip_assFx: 去掉 {\an8}、{\f4} 这类 SubStation 特效标记。这些标记在 SRT 里不生效，播放器会把它们当字显示出来。
zh-CN.tip_html: 去掉 <i>、<b>、<font> 这类标签，只保留里面的文字。很多播放器不支持这些标签，会原样显示成一串乱码。
zh-CN.tip_ctrl: 去掉看不见的控制字符、零宽字符和软连字符。它们不影响显示，但会破坏搜索和字数统计。
zh-CN.tip_sort: 按开始时间重新排序并重编号。不改变任何文字，只调整顺序。
zh-CN.tip_sdh: 去掉 [脚步声]、[音乐]、(咳嗽) 这类给听障观众看的音效描述。只去掉提示部分，对白原文保留。
zh-CN.tip_speaker: 去掉行首的「GEORGE:」这类说话人名字。注意：正片里出现「注意：」这种中文提示不会被误删。
zh-CN.tip_music: 删掉整条都是 ♪…♪ 的歌词行。带歌词的对白不受影响。开之前先想清楚：有些片子靠歌词传达信息。
zh-CN.tip_wm: 去掉字幕组水印、网址、邮箱、求关注和「仅供学习交流」这类广告。短条目里才判定，长台词不会被误伤。
zh-CN.tip_dup: 去掉时间轴和文字完全相同的重复条目，只保留第一条。
zh-CN.tip_empty: 去掉没有任何文字的空条目。
zh-CN.tip_punct: 清理多余空格、行尾空格和连续句点，不改动全角半角，也不重排引号。
zh-CN.tip_upper: 把整条全大写的字幕转成正常大小写，句首会自动大写。人名地名这类专有名词恢复不了，导出的英文片建议人工过一遍。
zh-CN.tip_merge: 把时长不足 1.2 秒、且间隔不到 0.4 秒的相邻两条合并成一条。字幕跳得太快时用它。
zh-CN.noChange: 没有需要清洗的地方，这份字幕已经是干净的。
zh-CN.pvMore: 只显示前 {n} 条，共 {t} 条 —— 完整内容请点「下载字幕」
zh-CN.okParse: 解析到 {n} 条 · 源格式 {f}

en.dzTxt: Drop a file here, or click to choose
en.pastePh: Or paste your subtitle text here
en.tip_assFx: Removes SubStation effect markers like {\an8}. They do nothing in SRT and show up as literal text.
en.tip_html: Removes <i>, <b>, <font> and keeps the text inside. Most players do not support them.
en.tip_ctrl: Removes invisible control, zero-width and soft-hyphen characters that break search and counting.
en.tip_sort: Re-sorts by start time and renumbers. Text is untouched.
en.tip_sdh: Removes sound descriptions for deaf viewers, such as [footsteps] or (coughs). Dialogue is kept.
en.tip_speaker: Removes leading speaker names like GEORGE:. Normal lines are not affected.
en.tip_music: Deletes cues that are nothing but ♪ lyrics ♪. Dialogue that quotes a lyric is kept.
en.tip_wm: Removes release-group watermarks, URLs, emails and ads. Only short cues are judged, so long dialogue is safe.
en.tip_dup: Removes cues with identical timing and text, keeping the first one.
en.tip_empty: Removes cues that contain no text at all.
en.tip_punct: Trims extra spaces and repeated dots. Never changes quotes or full-width forms.
en.tip_upper: Turns fully upper-case cues into normal case. Proper nouns cannot be restored, so proofread names.
en.tip_merge: Joins neighbours shorter than 1.2s with a gap under 0.4s. Useful when subtitles flicker.
en.noChange: Nothing to clean. This file is already tidy.
en.pvMore: Showing first {n} of {t} lines — download for the full file
en.assNote: ASS styling is treated as content; exports as SRT
en.outAssOff: ASS output needs an ASS source
en.outAssNote: Styles and resolution kept, only the text is replaced
en.biFound: Found {n} bilingual pairs, merged into one cue each
en.errParse: Could not parse any cues. Supported: SRT, VTT, ASS (and SSA).
en.errCopy: Copy failed, please select and copy manually
en.heroSub: Strip HTML tags, ASS effects, SDH cues, speaker labels and group watermarks, then fix all-caps and mojibake. Everything runs in your browser - the file is never uploaded.
